name: Tropiku Party
description: Head to the city's iconic rooftop cultural hub for a night of tropical beats with DJs Tropicáustica and Kebraku.
longDescription:
The Tropiku Party at Maus Hábitos on August 21, 2026, presents an evening focused on tropical music genres. The event features DJ sets from Tropicáustica and Kebraku, who will be curating the night's soundscape. This nightlife event is part of Maus Hábitos' ongoing cultural programming, offering a specific musical theme for attendees.

Attendees can expect an atmosphere centered around the selected musical styles, suitable for those interested in a dance-oriented evening. Maus Hábitos is known for its rooftop location, providing a distinct setting for events in Porto. The duration of the party will span several hours, typical of a club night.

This is a ticketed event. Maus Hábitos is located in the city center, approximately a 5-minute walk from São Bento metro and train station. The venue is situated on the fourth floor of a building, accessible via elevator.
